title: wildmat: WildmatPattern + GroupFilter types in core
description:
## What
Add WildmatPattern (single pattern with optional negation) and GroupFilter (ordered list with first-match-wins evaluation) to crates/core/src/wildmat.rs.

## Algorithm
1. Define pub enum WildmatError { AllNegation, EmptyPattern } in wildmat.rs
2. Define pub struct WildmatPattern { is_negated: bool, bare_pattern: String } — bare_pattern has leading '!' stripped
3. Impl WildmatPattern::parse(s: &str) -> Result<WildmatPattern, WildmatError>:
   a. If s starts with '!', set is_negated=true, bare_pattern=s[1..]
   b. Else is_negated=false, bare_pattern=s
   c. Return Err(EmptyPattern) if bare_pattern is empty
4. Define pub struct GroupFilter { patterns: Vec<WildmatPattern> }
5. Impl GroupFilter::new(raw_patterns: &[impl AsRef<str>]) -> Result<GroupFilter, WildmatError>:
   a. Parse each entry via WildmatPattern::parse
   b. Collect into Vec<WildmatPattern>
   c. Return Err(AllNegation) if patterns is empty OR all patterns have is_negated==true
6. Impl GroupFilter::accepts(&self, name: &str) -> bool:
   a. For each pattern in self.patterns (in order):
      - If matches_wildmat(name, &pattern.bare_pattern):
        - If pattern.is_negated: return false
        - Else: return true
   b. If no pattern matched: return false (default deny)
7. Do NOT use GroupFilter in config.rs yet (that is whss.3)

## Defensive programming rules
- GroupFilter::accepts('') must return false (empty name never matches any pattern)
- No unwrap() anywhere
- WildmatError must implement std::error::Error + Display
- GroupFilter::new([]) returns Err(AllNegation) (empty list = accept nothing, config error)

## Agent team
Critical-path: Agent R (read wildmat.rs after whss.1), Agent I_A (implement from spec), Agent I_B (independent implementation), Agent T (derive test vectors from RFC 3977 independently), Agent DIFF (reconcile I_A vs I_B against T's vectors)

## Tests (independent oracle: RFC 3977 §4.1 + epic acceptance criteria)
- accepts_star_crosses_dots: GroupFilter::new(&["comp.*"]) ok; .accepts("comp.lang.rust") = true
- accepts_star_no_match: same filter; .accepts("alt.test") = false
- negation_excludes_first_match: GroupFilter::new(&["comp.*", "sci.*", "!alt.binaries.*", "alt.test"]) ok; .accepts("alt.binaries.pictures") = false (negation matches before positive)
- positive_after_negation: same filter; .accepts("alt.test") = true (exact match after negation misses)
- exact_match: GroupFilter::new(&["alt.test"]) ok; .accepts("alt.test") = true; .accepts("alt.test2") = false
- default_deny: GroupFilter::new(&["comp.*"]) ok; .accepts("sci.math") = false (unmatched = deny)
- all_negation_rejected: GroupFilter::new(&["!comp.*"]) = Err(AllNegation)
- empty_vec_rejected: GroupFilter::new(&[] as &[&str]) = Err(AllNegation)
- case_insensitive: GroupFilter::new(&["comp.*"]) ok; .accepts("COMP.LANG.RUST") = true (RFC 3977 §4.1)
